data.content_ref: inline:Contradiction (counterexample-first): SRC_002's constant-in-(0.05,0.5) limit is directly contradicted by the jamming mechanism shared by SRC_003 and SRC_006 — monotone cut-size descent on a random 3-regular graph jams in a stable matching of crossing edges of LINEAR size whp, not in a Poisson-sparse set of obstructions. The constant-limit picture of SRC_004/SRC_002 implicitly assumes Θ(1) reachable obstructions, but the descent dynamics contradicts this: the final matching density ρ>0 concentrates, so the consensus probability tends to 0, not to 1−q. It is REFUTED IF simulations show the final crossing-edge density is o(n) whp or the basin of the empty cut is bounded away from 0 — exactly SRC_004's countercondition, which would vindicate SRC_002 instead.
